project_info.theme: Techcombank OneU exclusive soundcheck and concert ticket hunt
project_info.color_palette: Burning orange, lava red, white, black, ember glow

main_subject.detail: A fiery event-access poster with 'yeah1', 'PRODUCTION', and 'TECHCOMBANK' logos across the top. A red pill says '01 NGAY DUY NHAT'. The main headline reads 'SAN DAC QUYEN SOUNDCHECK & CONG DIEN 3'. In the center are two large torn-edge tickets leaning together, each printed with a metallic flaming crest emblem. Floating red U-point tokens appear around them. A huge date block at the bottom reads '12:00 Thu 6 | 17/07/2026'. The background is a lava-planet sky with rocky terrain and glowing embers.
main_subject.style: High-drama concert reward poster with fantasy lava atmosphere, metallic ticket emblem, and urgent limited-time event tone
